dia-direction-60-20260919.title: Industrial and conceptual sculpture
dia-direction-60-20260919.summary: 60 works exploring industrial materials, geometric form, landscape and conceptual space, including Jorge Oteiza, Eduardo Chillida, Nancy Holt and Robert Smithson.

diversity-60-20260918.title: Across cultures and centuries
diversity-60-20260918.summary: 60 additions connect ancient reliefs, African masks, Asian sculpture and Indigenous traditions with contemporary work, including Sol LeWitt’s open structures.

islamic-art-20260909.title: Arts of the Islamic world
islamic-art-20260909.summary: 50 religious, courtly and domestic objects bring together ceramics, calligraphy, metalwork, carved ivories and architectural ornament from Islamic societies.

collection-1000-batch4-20260909.title: Music, devotion and signs
collection-1000-batch4-20260909.summary: 40 works range from Chinese ritual bronzes and Polish devotional sculpture to Mapuche instruments, Guatemalan dance masks and Rapa Nui inscriptions.

collection-1000-batch3-20260909.title: Tools, offerings and memory
collection-1000-batch3-20260909.summary: 50 additions pair Chinese bronze vessels and Andean tools with funerary monuments, religious figures and objects of remembrance.

collection-1000-batch2-20260909.title: Figures, guardians and stories
collection-1000-batch2-20260909.summary: 50 works explore sacred figures and protective beings, with Hindu and Buddhist sculpture, European armor and fountains, and effigy vessels from the Americas.

collection-1000-batch1-20260909.title: Masks, vessels and monuments
collection-1000-batch1-20260909.summary: 50 works connect West African ceremonial masks, Andean vessels, Egyptian deities, Roman portraits and Chinese ritual bronzes.

ritual-life-20260909.title: Daily life and ceremony
ritual-life-20260909.summary: 30 objects shaped by use: musical instruments, writing tools, ritual vessels, household containers and architectural woodwork from several continents.

animals-20260909.title: Animals, real and imagined
animals-20260909.summary: 30 works portray animals as guardians, companions, sacred beings and vessels, from Chinese bronzes and Egyptian deities to netsuke and public sculpture.

intimacy-20260909.title: Forms of desire
intimacy-20260909.summary: 30 works explore adult nudes, embracing lovers, reclining figures and interpretations of Venus, from Roman fragments to modern and contemporary sculpture.

curves-20260909.title: The other side
curves-20260909.summary: 30 works invite a view around the sculpted body: crouching Aphrodites, athletes, bathers and torsos reveal the expressive possibilities of rear contours.

eros-20260909.title: Body and desire
eros-20260909.summary: Lovers, bathers, divine couples and representations of the adult body span prehistoric, classical and modern traditions.

diverse-round2-20260909.title: More works across time and place
diverse-round2-20260909.summary: 30 museum objects broaden the collection across Asia, Africa, the Americas and Oceania, including Thai vessels, Buddhist sculpture and works from Greenland and the Pacific.

diverse-collection-20260908.title: Across time and place
diverse-collection-20260908.summary: 30 museum works span prehistory to the nineteenth century, including Buddhist sculpture, West African masks, Maya ceramics and Rapa Nui wood figures.

homoerotic-readings-20260919.title: Bodies, intimacy and queer reception
homoerotic-readings-20260919.summary: A continuing group of three-dimensional works, with museum-documented queer reception and explicitly identified curatorial readings of adult intimacy.

new-additions-20260919.summary: The latest three-dimensional works added to Atrium.

new-additions-20260919-b.summary: The latest three-dimensional works added to Atrium.

sensual-sculpture-20260919-next.title: Reclining figures and divine couples
sensual-sculpture-20260919-next.summary: Seven works bring together reclining adult nudes, intimate mythological groups and sacred figures from Europe, India and Angkor.
